question: What auspicious matter concerning time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The speaker expresses a wish now.
The wish is to hear something.
That something is the auspicious deception of time.
inference: Now the speaker wishes to hear the auspicious deception of time.
uncertainties: How deception of time can be auspicious is not explained here.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
